mainEntity.name: What is included in a typical remodeling cost estimate from Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical remodeling cost estimate from Hometelligent Inc. includes a detailed breakdown of labor, materials, subcontractor costs, and permit fees. Our estimates are tailored to your specific project, whether it's a kitchen remodel in Emeryville or a bathroom renovation in Piedmont. We aim for transparency, clearly itemizing each component so you understand where your money is going. This often includes a preliminary schedule and payment milestones. Our goal is to provide a comprehensive and clear proposal that avoids hidden costs and sets clear expectations from the start.
